text:
marta: Heads-up — seeing an oscillation in kernel routing between Triton and CUTLASS for h100 pool when seqlen sits around 48-64. Routing flips every few seconds and p95 spikes ~15%.
ryan: I noticed similar in staging yesterday. Can repro with ramped qps and mixed seqlen. Logs show fallback events clustered with KV cache cold starts.
arjun: Do we have the telemetry that shows the decision score history? Is the arbiter sampling too aggressively?
marta: Here's my current read: when KV cache is cold/reshuffling, batch-smearing changes effective batch mem -> Cutlass is chosen for throughput, then next few requests see memory pressure -> arbiter flips back to Triton (more memory-stable) -> KV cache gets repopulated -> repeat. I think the sampling window and hysteresis are too tight.
ryan: Noticed the same pattern. Also saw a few CUDA transient alloc failures which triggered immediate fallback, even though steady-state would be fine.
marta: Proposal for a canary and tuning plan:

1) Increase probe interval to 60s (was 10s).
2) Add decision hysteresis: require 3 consecutive samples favoring X before switching.
3) Add a kv_hotness check: if kv_cache_hit_rate < 0.6 and seqlen in [48..64] bias towards Triton.
4) Separate "fallback" backoff counter from "decision" backoff so transient OOMs don't immediately flip routing.

Config snippet I plan to push:

```
kernel_arbiter:
  probe_interval_secs: 60
  min_consecutive_wins: 3
  kv_hotness_threshold: 0.6
  fallback_backoff_secs: 300
  decision_backoff_secs: 30
```

Thoughts?
arjun: SGTM. Two asks: log the per-request chosen_path and decision_score so we can graph the flip rate; and keep a small probe sample (0.5% traffic) so we get real-world mix.
bella: Also suggest adding a per-node probe budget to avoid correlated probes across replicas. And add a short circuit: if batch_size > X and mem_pressure high prefer Triton.
ryan: +1. And let's capture kv_cache_hit_rate, batch_smear_factor, and per-kernel memory peak in the telemetry. That'll help tune thresholds.
infra-bot: Created ticket PERF-1123 and dashboard perf/arbiter/oscillation. Links: https://internal.redwood/perf/1123 (added logs, flamegraphs, and raw decision traces).
marta: Plan for canary: 0.5% traffic, 6 hours window. Collect per-kernel latency, mem peaks, kv-hit, flip-count. Acceptance: oscillation rate < 5% and p95 improves or equal.
arjun: I can run the canary tomorrow morning and enable the extra telemetry flags.
bella: I'll add the gating change to arbiter to require min_consecutive_wins before commit.
ryan: I'll update the monitoring alert to catch oscillation > 8% during canary and auto-roll back.
marta: Nice. I'll open the PR for the config and add a short test harness to simulate the kv-cold->warm loop. Ping me when canary starts. :thumbsup:
ryan: Pinged in #oncall when canary starts so we can watch the dashboards.
bella: quick note — if we see persistent CUDA transient failures, we should consider a small increase to workspace allocation as a temporary mitigation.
marta: Agreed. Thanks all.
